normalattack.name: Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition
normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Generates threads that control her weapon using formulae, performing up to 3 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Summons the Facilitateur Automatise Generaliste Interactif et Omnitache, or "<color=#FFD780FF>Fagio</color>," and switches it to {LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK} mode: Unleashes a sweeping fire attack on enemies in front, as well as periodically fires condensed beams, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: The condensed beams will instead deal <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG.
While in <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding</color> mode, Fagio's {LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK} will continuously increase. Firing condensed beams will also further increase its <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color>.
<color=#FFD780FF>When Fagio's Decoding Power</color> reaches the maximum of 100 points, it switches to <color=#FFD780FF>Power Overdrive</color> mode, in which it fires at opponents with longer intervals, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. It will be unable to switch to <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding</color> mode at this time.
When not in <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> gradually decreases. When Sandrone is off-field, she will focus on maintaining Fagio, causing its <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> to decrease at 300% the original rate.
Fagio exits <color=#FFD780FF>Power Overdrive</color> mode when its <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> has decreased to under 50.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from midair to strike the ground below, dealing DMG to opponents along their path and causing AoE DMG on landing.

elementalskill.name: Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis
elementalskill.description: With her impeccable, ladylike poise, Sandrone boards the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech and hovers forward for 6s. During this time, Sandrone can control the travel direction of the craft. Pressing Sprint consumes 10 Stamina and launches her into an elegant high-speed hover mode, in which she will move even faster at the cost of 15 Stamina per second. When Sandrone starts hovering, if there are opponents nearby, she will also summon a Prismatic Resonance Cannon and fire 2 Prism Shots at any opponents who have yet to cool down, dealing Cryo DMG. Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The second Prism Shot will instead deal Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG. When on the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech, Sandrone will also elegantly and quietly repair Fagio, causing its {LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK} to decrease by 40 points when she starts her ride, and then by a further 10 points for every 0.1s she is on it. The turning of the gears in various machines, the precise point where the Primordial Sea freezes, the frequency at which the night songs gently drift in the air, the ancient laws of the tides' ebb and flow, and the rising and setting of the moon... All these can be brought under theorems reducible to clean, neat formulas. "Then it does us no harm to admit, as indeed we must, that our gods, our hopes, and the things we love â they can all be defined by reason."

elementalburst.name: Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.
elementalburst.description: In line with established ladylike behavior, Sandrone summons a large number of Prismatic Resonance Cannons for a frontal bombardment before firing on her foes with a Convective Inhibition Ray, dealing AoE Cryo DMG. Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Convective Inhibition Ray instead deals AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG. "I can believe in something so long as solid evidence can be produced for it. If not, then I will have to first prove it." "This is how a proper lady carries herself. She who submits to the unknown out of weakness of will cannot be called such."

p1.name: Archaic Calculation Engine
p1.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: When using the Elemental Skill {LINK#S11332}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis</color>{/LINK}, if Fagio's {LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK} is greater than 50, the second Prism Shot fired by Fagio at nearby opponents will deal 400% of its original DMG as Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> is decreased.\nAdditionally, for every 10 points of <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> Fagio loses, it gains 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Refined Tactics</color> for 60s (max 10 stacks). When Sandrone uses the Elemental Burst {LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.</color>{/LINK} while in the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state, all stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Refined Tactics</color> are cleared, causing the Convective Inhibition Ray to deal (100% + (no. of stacks cleared Ã5))% of its original DMG.

p2.name: A Lady's Code of Conduct
p2.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: Increases Sandrone's Elemental Mastery based on her ATK. Every 100 ATK will increase her Elemental Mastery by 8. The maximum increase she can gain this way is 160.

p3.name: Light of Rationalisme
p3.description: When your party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct, and your party members' Base Stellar-Conduct DMG will be increased based on Sandrone's ATK: Every 100 ATK she has increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.7%. The maximum increase that can be gained this way is 14%.\nAdditionally, when Sandrone is within a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, she will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state.

p4.name: A Caucus Prelude and a Long Tale
p4.description: When Sandrone is in the party, you will gain additional snack rewards after turning in your Daily Commissions with Katheryne.

const1.name: Morrow After the Golden Dusk
const1.description: When in {LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK} mode, Fagio's {LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK} increases at a 50% lower rate, and all party members deal 30% increased Stellar-Conduct DMG.

const2.name: An Heiress Gazed Into the Looking-Glass
const2.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: Increases Charged Attack condensed beam DMG by 100% of Sandrone's ATK. Also, each time a beam is fired, DMG dealt by all condensed beams fired during this {LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK} mode period will be further increased by 40% of Sandrone's ATK (max 3 stacks).

const3.name: Refuse the Wake of Dusk, the Moonlit Yoke
const3.description: Increases the Level of {LINK#S11331}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition</color>{/LINK} by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

const4.name: In Knowledge Lies the World's True Ground
const4.description: When Sandrone deals Stellar-Conduct DMG, she will also summon an extra Prismatic Resonance Cannon to fire off a coordinated attack which deals <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> at 125% of her ATK. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG, and the effect can occur once every 4s.

const5.name: Of All Beside, She Takes No Part
const5.description: Increases the Level of {LINK#S11331}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.</color>{/LINK} by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

const6.name: Narcissus Wakes, Her Eyes Upon the Dawn
const6.description: When Fagio fires a condensed beam for the third time while in {LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK} mode, the beam becomes a more powerful <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> that fires continuously. This beam will deal up to 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> at 75% of Sandrone's ATK on top of any subsequent original beam fired. <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> will instead deal 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> at 50% of Sandrone's ATK. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG.\nAdditionally, all Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by Sandrone is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 20%.

hyperlinks.name: Elevation
hyperlinks.description: Special DMG Boost effect. It is calculated independently of other DMG Boost effects.

hyperlinks.name: Decoding
hyperlinks.description: Fagio will switch to this mode when using a Charged Attack.\nWhen in this mode, Fagio will engage any opponents ahead with a sweeping fire attack, as well as fire condensed beams at intervals, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.\nRadiance: Stellar-Conduct: The condensed beams will instead deal AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG.

hyperlinks.name: Decoding Power
hyperlinks.description: When in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power will continuously increase. When its Decoding Power reaches the maximum, Fagio will be unable to maintain or re-enter Decoding mode.

hyperlinks.name: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct
hyperlinks.description: When Stellar-Conduct is triggered, the surrounding area will transform into a Polestar Field for a short period of time, and when Sandrone is inside a Polestar Field she will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state, which grants various buffs to her skills.
